description: This file defines classes and functions for generating code snippets for HTTP requests in multiple programming languages (JavaScript, Python, C#, Java). It includes classes implementing an interface for each language, with methods to produce code that makes HTTP requests using Playwright, and a factory function to select the appropriate generator based on language.

classes.name: JSCodeGen
classes.description: Generates JavaScript code snippets for HTTP requests using Playwright.

classes.name: PythonCodeGen
classes.description: Generates Python code snippets for HTTP requests using Playwright.

classes.name: CSharpCodeGen
classes.description: Generates C# code snippets for HTTP requests using Playwright.

classes.name: JavaCodeGen
classes.description: Generates Java code snippets for HTTP requests using Playwright.

methods.name: generatePlaywrightRequestCall
methods.description: Creates code to perform an HTTP request in the target language, based on a har.Request object and optional body.

methods.name: getAPIRequestCodeGen
methods.description: Factory function returning an instance of the appropriate code generator class based on the specified language.
